about:
# Parchment Reader

Parchment Reader is an in-game library for World of Warcraft. Save stories,
notes, roleplay material, and other long-form text, then read it in a focused,
resizable window.

## Features

- Create, edit, and organize saved books and notes.
- Rename books while keeping their bookmarks and reading positions.
- Recover deleted saved books and notes for 30 days through a quiet Trash window
  in Settings > General > Maintenance.
- Switch between Library, Favorites, and the 20 most recently opened books.
- Sort Library and Favorites by title, by most recently modified, or by most recently added.
- Search titles and collections by default, or enable the compact **Aa** scope
  to find a complete phrase in book content within the active collection.
- Open a content result with Enter or a click, highlight the matching phrase,
  move between occurrences, and return without replacing saved reading progress.
- Read continuously with automatic position saving.
- Group books into collections.
- Keep the line breaks of poems, lists, and notes per book with **Keep Line Breaks**
  in the book menu; other books keep joining hard-wrapped prose into paragraphs.
- Add, rename, navigate, delete, and restore bookmarks, ordered by reading position.
- Reopen the bookmark list at the selected bookmark. Repeated **+ Here** clicks
  at the same exact point select the existing bookmark and keep its name.
- Keep older duplicate bookmarks independently usable, including rename and Undo.
- Read clearer bookmark titles and excerpts with separate progress percentages,
  wrapped hover excerpts with continuation ellipses, and a theme-colored rename pencil.
- Capture text quickly without leaving the game through Quick Note.
- Resume the last saved Quick Note in its current collection, or start a new
  note without losing an unsaved draft.
- Use Compact Mode or minimize the reader to a movable floating icon.
- Assign a shortcut that switches a visible Reader into or out of Compact Mode.
- Keep the Reader or minimized launcher in its saved screen position between
  sessions, and pin the Reader to prevent accidental movement or resizing.
- Enable keyboard navigation only when the book page has focus, leaving
  gameplay keys available to WoW at other times.
- Configure reader size, font, transparency, shortcuts, and minimap access, with
  an optional transparent background override while in combat.
- Adjust line spacing from 2 to 10 pixels in **Settings > Reading**, next to
  Font size; the reader updates immediately and keeps your place.
- Choose Off, Always, Smart, or Custom reader transparency. Custom reveals a
  live 0–100% slider and a Transparent until hovered checkbox. Text keeps its
  opacity; at high transparency in a light theme, use Azeroth Glass or enable
  Transparent until hovered to keep reading comfortable.
- Choose Azeroth Glass, Light Parchment, Warm Parchment, Leatherbound, Gray UI, or Forever,
  and assign the sun/moon switch independently. Leatherbound combines dark leather
  with pale paper; Gray UI uses native quest parchment, graphite panels and red
  buttons. Forever adds warm panels, gold frames and native red/gold controls.
  Click an appearance preview or page through choices without applying
  them. Themes update open windows immediately.
- Seasonal appearances are offered by the addon release. Hallow's End is now
  retired, restoring the previous ordinary theme while keeping your seasonal
  preference for its return.
- On WoW Forever, a one-time Forever appearance invitation offers **Enable now** or
  **Later**. You can also choose Forever in **Settings > Appearance**.
- Discover seasonal appearance through a localized invitation, with improved
  collection scrollbar dragging and clearer list-row separators.
- Find settings in Reading, Appearance, Controls, and General, with a live font
  sample and theme previews.
- Choose the interface language independently of the WoW client: English,
  German, French, Russian, Spanish, or Brazilian Portuguese.

## Supported clients

- World of Warcraft Retail, including 12.1.5
- Mists of Pandaria Classic
- Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary
- Classic Era, Hardcore, and Season of Discovery
- WoW Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001)

All supported clients share one package. World of Warcraft automatically selects
the appropriate manifest. From 2.5.2 on, one CurseForge and Wago file is tagged
for every client, including WoW Forever 1.60.1. Releases 2.0.0 to 2.5.1 published
Forever as a separate CurseForge file containing the same addon.

The Forever package retains the native `_Camelot` manifest suffix confirmed in
the original Beta. The local installation audit on 2026-11-04 found client
1.60.1.70755 in `_forever_`; the existing Interface 16001 manifest target remains
unchanged for that patch. This records the installed build, not a new in-game check.

The original Forever Beta loader and API diagnostic passed on client
1.60.1.70205 (Interface 16001), Classic Beta PvP. The owner confirmed all six
focused addon game checks passed there on 2026-10-03, including persistence
after reload and a full client restart. The separate CurseForge 2.0.0 Forever
file was owner-confirmed Approved on 2026-10-03. The original GitHub 2.0.0
archive predates that additional manifest. The 2.0.1 package contains all five
manifests. Through 2.5.1 Forever used a separate CurseForge file tagged only for
1.60.1; its addon payload was identical to the standard package.
The custom-transparency update was accepted in Retail on 2026-10-05; additional
client checks for this bounded change were waived by the owner.

## Downloads

The latest published release, **2.7.0**, adds **Keep Line Breaks** to the book
menu, so poems, lists, and notes can show every line exactly as written, while
other books keep joining hard-wrapped prose into paragraphs. New Quick Notes keep
their line breaks automatically. It builds on 2.6.0, which added the **Recently
added** sort order. WoW Forever uses the same CurseForge and Wago download as
every other client. Existing
books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor
drafts are preserved. All supported clients remain in the shared package.

- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/parchment-reader)
- [Wago Addons](https://addons.wago.io/addons/parchment-reader)
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Helsdar/ParchmentReader/releases)

## Installation

1. Extract the archive.
2. Copy the `ParchmentReader` folder into the `Interface\AddOns` directory for
   the client you play.
3. Restart World of Warcraft and enable **Parchment Reader** in the AddOns list.

The final path should look like:

```text
World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\ParchmentReader\ParchmentReader.toc
```

Use `_classic_`, `_anniversary_`, or `_classic_era_` instead of `_retail_` for
the corresponding Classic client. For WoW Forever,
use `_forever_` and keep `ParchmentReader_Camelot.toc` alongside the base
manifest.

## Getting started

- Left-click the minimap icon to show or hide the reader.
- Right-click the minimap icon to open settings.
- Ctrl + left-click the minimap icon to open Quick Note.
- Drag the minimap icon to reposition it.
- Use **+ Add Book** to create your first saved book.
- Use Library, Favorites, and Recent below the search field. Right-click a book
  to change its favorite status, keep its line breaks, edit it, or move it to
  another collection.
- Right-click Recent to clear reading history after confirmation.
- Use the sort button next to the search field to choose **Title (A-Z)**,
  **Recently modified** or **Recently added**. Recent keeps its last-opened order.
- Use **Move to Trash** from a book's context menu or
  editor, then use **Settings > General > Maintenance > Open Trash**. Inspect a deleted record and
  choose **Restore** or **Delete Permanently**; **Empty Trash** clears confirmed
  entries. Restoring preserves dates, reading position, bookmarks and Favorite,
  uses a unique title if necessary, and falls back to **No Collection** if the
  original collection is gone. Entries expire 30 days after deletion; expiry
  while the game is closed is processed when the addon next loads.
- Change a book's title in Edit Book; titles must be unique in its collection.
- Open Quick Note and use **Resume** to continue its last saved note. Assign
  **Resume Last Quick Note** in Controls or WoW Key Bindings for direct access.
  Resume becomes available after your first Quick Note save in this version.
- Use the search field for title and collection terms. Toggle **Aa** for content
  phrases, then press Enter to open the first result or click another result.
- Use the contextual footer arrows to move between content matches and **×** to
  return to the ordinary saved reading position.
- Click the book page before using keyboard navigation; click outside it or
  press Escape to return keyboard control to WoW.
- Use the Pin button in the Reader header to lock its position and size and
  restore it after reloads or logins.
- Open **Keyboard Help** in the reader or editor to see available shortcuts.
- In Appearance, choose **Custom — adjust transparency** to show the slider
  and **Transparent until hovered** option.
- Choose **Forever** in **Settings > Appearance**, or use **Enable now** in the
  WoW Forever invitation. **Later** dismisses that news without changing your
  design; it does not repeat on the next open or reload.
- Hallow's End is retired in this update. Seasonal controls return when a future
  release offers an event; your saved preference and ordinary theme are retained.
  Availability is supplied by the addon release; it does not follow the calendar.

## Commands

- `/reader` — show or hide the reader.
- `/reader refresh` — refresh the reader interface.
- `/pr` — short alias for `/reader`.

## Unsaved drafts

Add/Edit Book and Quick Note each retain one unsaved draft across ordinary
`/reload` and relog. The next editor opening offers **Restore** or **Delete
Draft**, with its title and date. Escape leaves the draft for later. Drafts are
shared between characters using the same database and do not expire.

Successful Save, confirmed Discard Changes, or returning all fields to their
original values clears the draft. A failed Save keeps it. If the original book
changed or disappeared, restore the text as a separate copy. This supports
normal reloads/logouts and is not a crash-recovery guarantee.

## Saved data

Books, collections, bookmarks, reading positions, settings, and unsaved editor
drafts are stored by World of Warcraft in the account-wide `ParchmentReaderDB`.
Back up the account's `WTF` directory before updating the addon, reinstalling the
game, or moving to another computer.
Version 2.0.1 retains books, bookmarks, and reading progress, adding only the
custom transparency amount and hover preference to settings.
Version 2.0.2 improves bookmark presentation without changing saved books,
bookmarks, or reading progress.
Version 2.0.3 updates compatibility and package-version metadata only;
books, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and their saved format are unchanged.
Version 2.0.4 improves bookmark navigation and hover excerpts while preserving
existing bookmark records, names, and saved data format.
Version 2.1.0 preserves books, bookmarks, reading progress, and
ordinary theme choices. Seasonal preferences and invitation seen state persist
between sessions; reinstalling does not reset the invitation.
Version 2.1.1 adds `editorDrafts` with separate Add/Edit Book and Quick Note
slots. These drafts are shared across characters using the same database and
remain separate from saved books. Existing books, collections, bookmarks,
reading progress, and settings are preserved; no saved-data reset is required.
Version 2.2.0 adds a shared Trash for deleted saved books and Quick Notes.
Restoring retains their saved metadata; records expire 30 days after deletion.
Unsaved editor drafts remain separate and do not expire.

Version 2.3.0 preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts. New appearances and news do not reset data
or change the sun/moon assignments. Hallow's End retirement restores the saved
ordinary appearance while retaining the seasonal preference.

Version 2.4.0 preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts. Line spacing defaults to the previous
value; no saved-data reset is required.

Version 2.5.0 preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts. Sorting defaults to the previous title
order and never changes saved dates; no saved-data reset is required.

Version 2.5.1 is a visual polish release. It preserves books, collections,
bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts; no saved-data
reset is required.

Version 2.5.2 is a visual fix release and the first single download that also
covers WoW Forever. It preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts; no saved-data reset is required.

Version 2.6.0 preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts. Sorting still defaults to title order, and
Recently added only reads existing creation dates; no saved-data reset is required.

Version 2.7.0 preserves books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress,
settings, and unsaved editor drafts. Existing books keep their current layout
until you choose Keep Line Breaks; no saved-data reset is required.

releases.name: Parchment Reader 2.7.0
releases.notes:
# Parchment Reader 2.7.0

- Added **Keep Line Breaks** to the book menu. Right-click a book and choose it for poems, lists, or notes where every line ending matters; the book then shows each line exactly as written. Choose it again to return to flowing paragraphs.
- Without this choice, long lines that were broken up when copied from a website or document are still joined into paragraphs, as before. The choice applies to one book at a time.
- Switching keeps your reading position and bookmarks in place and does not change the book's place in **Recently modified**.
- New **Quick Notes** keep their line breaks automatically, so pressing Enter after a long sentence starts a new line just as you typed it.

Existing books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts are preserved, and existing books keep their current layout. No saved-data reset is required. One shared package includes every supported client manifest.

releases.name: Parchment Reader 2.6.0
releases.notes:
# Parchment Reader 2.6.0

- Added a third sort order, **Recently added**. Choose it from the sort button next to the search field to list your newest books first.
- **Recently added** uses the date a book was created, so editing, renaming, or moving a book does not change its place. Books without a saved creation date follow. It works in Library and Favorites together with collection and search filters, and **Recent** keeps its last-opened order.

Existing books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts are preserved. The default order matches previous versions. No saved-data reset is required. One shared package includes every supported client manifest.

releases.name: Parchment Reader 2.5.2
releases.notes:
# Parchment Reader 2.5.2

- In the **Gray UI** and **Forever** appearances, the current **Aa** content-search match is highlighted in dark red again instead of almost matching the text.
- The **Move To** scroll hint now shows arrows instead of an empty box when there are more collections than fit.
- The minimized floating icon and its menu now always use the dark Azeroth Glass look, without a shadow, whichever appearance you choose.
- WoW Forever now uses the same CurseForge and Wago download as every other client.

Existing books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts are preserved. No saved-data reset is required. One shared package includes every supported client manifest.

releases.name: Parchment Reader 2.5.1
releases.notes:
# Parchment Reader 2.5.1

- Small menus and popovers no longer cast a dark outer shadow over the reading page and sidebar. This covers the Recent, collection and book context menus, **Move To**, the bookmark list, the floating icon's menu and the Book Editor collection picker. Windows and dialogs keep their shadow.
- In the **Forever** appearance, these menus now use the same plain border as the sort menu.

Existing books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts are preserved. No saved-data reset is required. One shared package includes every supported client manifest.

releases.name: Parchment Reader 2.5.0
releases.notes:
# Parchment Reader 2.5.0

- Added **library sorting**. Use the new sort button next to the search field to switch between **Title (A-Z)** and **Recently modified**.
- **Recently modified** lists the books you most recently saved, renamed, or moved first; books without a saved date follow. Sorting applies to Library and Favorites together with collection and search filters, and **Recent** keeps its last-opened order.
- Your sort choice is remembered; **Reset to Defaults** restores Title.
- On **WoW Forever**, the Forever appearance invitation no longer appears once you have used the Forever appearance.

Existing books, collections, bookmarks, reading progress, settings, and unsaved editor drafts are preserved. The default order matches previous versions. No saved-data reset is required. One shared package includes every supported client manifest.
